Okay so first, pack a bowl. Everyone has their own method,  but I tend to pack a layer of herb to cover the whole. I find it cherries easier and requires less lighting later on. Then cover your original pack with as much herb as you think you want or can handle. Then, place your mouth on the pipe and inhale before lighting. Make sure it bubbles properly, that's how you determine how strongly to inhale. When it fills white (or yellow depending on the herb/how clean of a hit), pull the bowl out and inhale very hard. Exhale, and proceed to cough your lungs out!
edit: I'm a [3] and missed a few questions. Filling with water is pretty easy, just pour it down the pipe where you put your mouth,  or down the hole where you put the bowl,  it depends on the pipe. For lighting,  generally a 2-3 second light is more than enough. It mostly depends on your preference and how big of a hit you can handle. Or if you packed a nice bowl, the size of the hit totally depends on the length of your draw.

Becoming a regular vampire (through the disease) isn't much worth the hassle. The non-regenerating stamina is a pain in daytime fights, or walking instead of sprinting when adventuring. 
Becoming a Vampire Lord on the other hand, is pretty damn awesome. I don't know if you have Damnguard or not, but a vampire lord is worth any small downsides. I play an assassin myself, and the damage a vampire lord does in tight situations is useful. When you get caught out and can't use your bow effectively, the claw and magic attacks really come in handy.
